articles.summary: Eneco is an international energy company serving millions of residential customers across the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany. Now, with the rapid growth of residential distributed energy resources (DERs) – the EV market alone is set to double in the Netherlands and Belgium by 2029 – Eneco is preparing to extend their VPP to the home. Their goal: empower consumers to better manage their energy use, contribute to grid stability, and offer possibilities to lower their energy bills.
